# Which MODULE_API entries the C (libdragon) backend can lower, and to what.
# Generated by tcl/tools/libdragon_symbols.tcl --regen; do not hand-edit.
#
#   libdragon  declared by libdragon itself
#   tiny3d     needs `tiny3d = true` in pak.toml
#   missing    Pak advertises it and nothing implements it
#
# Entries lowered through CG_API_LAMBDA are absent on purpose: they become
# an expression, not a bare call, and libdragon_api_test.tcl checks those.
